title: Spicy Korean Cabbage and Spring Onion Pancake
summary: A crisp-edged, savoury Korean-style pancake packed with cabbage, spring onions and chilli heat. It makes a quick vegan breakfast with a tender centre and golden, crunchy outside.

ingredients.name: spring onions, cut into 5 cm lengths

steps: Whisk the plain flour, cornstarch, salt and chilli powder in a large bowl until evenly mixed.
Add the cold vegetable stock and whisk to a smooth, fairly loose batter. Fold in the shredded cabbage, spring onions and sliced chilli until the vegetables are well coated.
Stir the tamari, rice vinegar, sesame oil and sesame seeds together in a small bowl to make the dipping sauce.

Heat 1.5 tbsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add half the batter and spread it into a thin pancake, pressing the vegetables down so they make contact with the pan.
Cook for 4–5 minutes until the underside is deep golden and crisp and the top looks mostly set around the edges.
Flip carefully, add another small drizzle of oil around the edge if the pan looks dry, and cook for 3–4 minutes more until crisp, browned and cooked through.
Repeat with the remaining oil and batter to make a second pancake. Slice and serve hot with the dipping sauce.
